answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by issuing an agent identity only after remote attestation proves that a live TEE runs authorized code, binding the identity cryptographically to its enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE). A copied VM may duplicate software, but it cannot forge the enclave’s hardware-rooted attestation key; cloning an identity therefore requires purchasing physical silicon and provisioning another attested enclave, not virtual-machine duplication. Thus ocean, atlas, and vertex are accountable nodes.
